title: Geography & Map Expert (AI Community)
description:
About the Role:
Do you have a degree in Geography or Urban Planning? AI models power the maps we use every day for delivery and travel, but they often struggle to understand the real world. At TELUS Digital, we are looking for Geography enthusiasts to be the "eyes on the ground" for our AI. You will look at satellite images and maps to make sure the AI is identifying roads, buildings, and landmarks correctly. You help the AI understand exactly where things are.
What You’ll Do (Simple Tasks):

• Confirming Landmarks: Look at a photo from space and tell the AI: "Yes, that is a hospital," or "No, that is actually a shopping mall."

• Route Checking: Look at a map and make sure the AI isn't suggesting a route that is impossible (like driving a car through a park or a walking path).

• Naming Places: Use your local knowledge to make sure the AI is using the correct names for neighborhoods, streets, and natural features in your region.

• Environmental Tagging: Help the AI identify things like forests, rivers, or new construction sites on a map.

Qualification path
Mandatory Qualifications:

• Education: A minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Geography, Urban Planning, or Environmental Science.

• Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language. You know your local area better than any global map does.

• English Proficiency: Basic (B1) English to communicate with our project team.

Visual Accuracy: You are good at reading maps and recognizing shapes and patterns in satellite photos.
Assessment:
In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.
Payment:
Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour
Our Payment terms are defined for each project.

• Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

• Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

• Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

• Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: TECH401: Security and Data Protection Lead
description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.
Areas of Focus - Technical Operations, Governance, Data Privacy

• Identity & Access Management: Implement and manage robust authentication services and access controls to ensure only authorized contributors have access to sensitive systems.

• Cybersecurity Risk Management: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and manage the remediation of technical security gaps across the organization's platforms.

• Incident Response: Serve as the primary responder for security incidents, developing and maintaining the organizational incident response plan to minimize impact.

• Security Architecture: Oversee the technical focus of cloud-based security configurations, ensuring tools like Google Workspace and other internal systems are hardened against threats.

• Data Protection Framework: Develop and enforce policies specifically tailored to data protection, ensuring compliance with relevant privacy standards and best practices.

• Risk Governance: Translate high-level strategic direction into actionable policies and procedural documentation that can be easily followed by non-technical volunteers.

• Awareness & Culture: Drive security awareness training for all JerseySTEM members, fostering a culture of "Security First" across the organization.

• Insider Threat Mitigation: Establish monitoring and auditing processes to protect against internal data leakage and unauthorized data sharing.

Overview
Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately 6-8 flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K-12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit. JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.
Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda. Role Overview Reporting to The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Security and Data Protection Lead is a high-impact role designed for an experienced professional who can bridge the gap between strategic direction and technical execution. You will be responsible for safeguarding JerseySTEM ’s digital assets and ensuring the privacy of our community's data.
This role blends hands-on implementation with tactical oversight, focusing on building a practical framework programs and policies for our security posture while maintaining the agility required for a non-profit environment.
Qualifications
Qualifications & Requirements

• 8+ years of proven experience in cybersecurity, information security, or data privacy roles.

• Ability to work independently as a “doer”, taking ownership of tasks from conception to completion.

• Strong understanding of technical security controls (IAM, encryption, network security) and governance frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001).

• Partner with the JerseySTEM TECH and non-technical team to prioritize and incorporate security perspectives into tools and workflows

• Draft, socialize, and maintain right-sized security policies, standards, and procedures appropriate for a nonprofit organization.

• Stay current on evolving threats (including AI-enabled threats) and share relevant, actionable recommendations with leadership and technical teams.

• Excellent communication skills to advise leadership on security architecture and risk.

• Comfortable working in a fully remote, member-driven organization.

• Commitment: Ability to dedicate approximately one working day (6-8 hours) per week to have a tangible impact.

• Relevant certifications are a plus but not required (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security+, CCSP, GIAC).

• Exposure to AI/ML security considerations helpful, not required.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - KYC
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

- We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

- We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

- We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location: Remote - Canada

 

About the Role:

As a backend-focused Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, constructing, and maintaining APIs, services, and systems across our engineering team. This multifaceted position involves developing new features on a large scale, refining internal tooling and processes, contributing to product and technical roadmaps, and assuming diverse responsibilities within the organization. The ideal candidate for the backend role will have a proven track record in building highly available APIs, with additional proficiency in data pipelines and the relevant domain.

 

What you'll be doing:

- Design, create, and maintain robust, efficient, and reliable backend services to meet our platform's evolving needs.

- Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to architect and implement new services from inception to delivery.

- Contribute to developing new features and capabilities that deliver substantial value to our customers.

- Work with various engineering and product teams to synchronize efforts and deliver cutting-edge solutions.

- Craft and maintain user-facing technical documentation, enhancing user understanding and facilitating seamless adoption of our services.

- Play a pivotal role in shaping our company's engineering culture, ensuring the maintenance of high engineering standards across the organization.

 

What you’ll need:

- 7+ years of proven experience as a Software Engineer specializing in web backend development.

- Proficiency in Golang is a significant advantage.

- Additional experience in data engineering is highly desirable.

- A track record of successfully delivering high-quality production services and systems.

- Customer-centric approach with a strong emphasis on empathy towards users.

- Relevant industry experience, particularly in banking or fintech, and domain knowledge in fraud prevention or compliance.

- Proficient in English - from casual chats to formal reports.

 

Technologies we use:

- TypeScript (React + node)

- Golang

- Ruby

- Bigtable

- Postgres / PostgreSQL

- GCP dataflow (apache beam)

- BigQuery

- Python

- Java

- Terraform

Benefits we offer:

- Generous compensation in cash and equity

- Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

- Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

- Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

- Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

- 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

- MacBook Pro delive

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Flow Traders is seeking a highly capable, experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at our Amsterdam HQ. In this pivotal role, you will provide high-level administrative and strategic support directly to the CEO, ensuring the seamless management of the CEO’s day-to-day activities and enabling the CEO to focus on key business priorities and strategic decision-making at a global level. 

You will be a trusted partner to the CEO, taking full ownership of a complex and fast-moving schedule, coordinating a high volume of internal and external engagements, and anticipating needs before they arise. This role requires sound judgement, confidence, discretion and the ability to stay several steps ahead in a dynamic international environment.  

What you will do

• Manage the CEO’s complex calendar, communications and international travel across multiple time zones

• Act as a trusted gatekeeper, prioritising competing demands and ensuring the CEO’s time is used effectively

• Coordinate senior-level meetings, business trips and roadshows, including agendas, itineraries, logistics and briefing materials

• Act as a key liaison between the CEO, Management Board, internal teams and external stakeholders

• Support board meetings, offsites and strategic or cross-functional projects

• Work closely with other Executive Assistants to provide seamless support and coverage

What you need to succeed

• A minimum of 5 years working experience as an Executive Assistant

• Exceptional calendar management, organisation and prioritisation skills, with experience managing complex schedules and international travel

• Highly proactive and solutions-oriented, with excellent judgement and the confidence to take initiative independently

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to work with senior internal and external stakeholders

• High level of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information

• Calm, adaptable and highly organised, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively under pressure

• Strong attention to detail, ownership and follow-through, with a collaborative and hands-on approach

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and collaboration and AI platforms (Claude, Copilot, SharePoint)

• Comfortable working 5 days a week in the office and and working flexible hours

The Opportunity

This position is a great opportunity for a strategic, creative, and AI-savvy marketer with a proven track record of designing and executing multi-channel enterprise B2B marketing programs that start conversations and drive and accelerate pipeline at scale.
This director owns solution campaign marketing for North American growth accounts- the broad base of prospect and early-stage accounts across FICO 's target industries. This role is the engine that feeds the Pods, which are responsible for expansion of our FICO ® Platform solution across our existing customer accounts.

• Serve as the strategic solution campaign marketing lead for all NorAm growth accounts. You’ll set priorities and orchestrate execution, collaborating with FICO ’s digital, value messaging team, events, and SDR teams without direct management authority - requiring strong influence and coalition-building skills.

• Design and execute well-orchestrated, scalable multi-channel campaigns incorporating email, webinars, advertising, tradeshows, and other 1:Many tactics to create awareness and interest across account base and convert it into qualified pipeline. • Build and maintain a strong partnership with NorAm Sales leadership and Pod leads, and nurture ongoing relationships with account managers, the SDR team, and other internal stakeholders.

• Develop messaging strategies and content for emails, webinars, and events, collaborating closely with product marketing and other stakeholders.

• Partner with the events team to plan and execute outstanding tradeshows and customer-specific events (approximately 10-25% travel expected).

• Identify white-space growth opportunities across the assigned NorAm account base within the context of the fiscal sales plan and multi-year regional strategy, and build the pipeline of accounts ready to graduate into the Pod model.

• Deep knowledge of complex selling environments in the B2B technology world and what it takes to build brand and product awareness and pipeline.

• 10 to 15 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, with a demonstrated ability to operate at a strategic level and lead through influence rather than direct authority.

title: Merchant Growth Specialist
description:
Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel.
Full-time
About SOUS
SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.
Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.
Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.
We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.
About the role
Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers.

title: Senior Functional Safety Engineer
description:
Our Electronics Tech Center in Brasov focuses on the innovation, development and testing of electronic applications in the Safety area (Active Seatbelts & Steering Wheels), coordinating end-to-end projects for OEMs. We are looking for a Senior Functional Safety Engineer to join our Electronics and Mechatronics team. In this role, you will conduct safety activities, will provide feedback and guidance to the engineering design teams for systems, hardware, and software on system safety findings and recommend design changes to improve automotive embedded safety systems. You will be responsible for ensuring that the functional safety of our products is achieved.
What will you do?

• Manage activities according to ISO 26262, plan System Safety Activities with respect to Project Time schedules

• Participate in Safety Analyses of system, subsystem, hardware and software architectures. Safety Analyses include HARA, DFMEA, FTA, DFA, ETA

• Specify and document safety concepts and requirements for safety architecture including HW and SW aspects

• Communicate to engineering design teams the system safety aspects and communicate what is required to meet specified safety integrity levels

• Review System and Discipline Test Plans and Specifications to ensure compliance with safety plan with respect to the verification of derived Safety concepts

• Interface with Customers regarding the technical safety aspects for the system and support quoting proposals

• Interface with Quality Assurance (IATF 16949)

• Collaborate with supporting processes

• Conclude on functional safety of the products, based on Safety Case

What will you bring?

• Minimum Bachelor’s Degree, Computer Science and Engineering preferred

• Previous experience in functional safety implementation in an automotive environment, applying safety according to ISO 26262 standard

• Good understanding of embedded Software engineering and Hardware engineering domains

• Background in Embedded Electronic Controls systems (E.g. Brake, Airbag, Steering)

• Safety requirements analysis at the system, hardware, and software level

• Knowledge of Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA), FTA, DFMEA

• Previous experience with Dependent Failure, Common cause analysis, Freedom From Interference Analysis, Maintenance Safety Analysis

• Strong view on implementation of Quality Management in process

title: Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance
description:
ABOUT STORD

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord , brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord ’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord is hiring a Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance to own how we recognize, record and defend revenue across a business that blends warehousing, fulfillment, parcel and software. There is no dedicated revenue accounting team today, so you will own the function from day one: set the technical accounting position under ASC 606, and build the assurance program that gives our CFO, auditors and board confidence in every revenue number we report. What You'll Do

Revenue accounting

• Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close, including accruals for usage-based fulfillment, storage, transportation and parcel charges, and unbilled revenue.

• Own ASC 606 analysis for new and amended customer contracts (MSAs, SOWs, pricing schedules): performance obligations, principal vs. agent, variable consideration, contract modifications and software vs. services allocation.

• Own the revenue recognition policy, technical memos and the revenue recognition playbook, and keep them current as the product mix changes.

• Own the reserves for customer credits (such as service and SLA credits), including the estimation methodology, monthly true-ups and support for auditors.

• Own revenue analytics: revenue by customer, service line and contract, flux and trend analysis, and the metrics that explain revenue movement to Finance leadership.

• Partner with Billing and Systems to make sure contract terms, rate cards and billing data flow accurately into the general ledger.

Assurance and Controls

• Design, run and continuously improve the revenue control environment: SOX-readiness controls, reconciliations, billing-to-GL tie-outs and revenue completeness checks.

• Build an assurance program that tests revenue before it reaches the auditors, using data and analytics to catch billing leakage, duplicate charges and rate-card variances.

• Be the primary revenue contact for external auditors: PBC lists, walkthroughs, technical accounting positions and remediation of findings.

• Prepare for audit, diligence and potential IPO readiness requirements, including disclosures and footnote support.

Leadership

• Lead and scale the revenue accounting function: hands-on today, with any team build-out to be determined as business needs evolve.

• Drive automation of revenue workflows, reconciliations and flux analysis with the finance systems stack.

• Brief the CFO and Controller on revenue trends, risks and judgments.

What You'll Bring

• Bache

title: Chef de programme transformation digitale

La mission couvre la cohérence globale du programme, l'alignement entre les besoins métier et les choix technologiques, la gouvernance, le pilotage budgétaire ainsi que la coordination des intervenants internes et externes.
Gouvernance et pilotage du programme

• Structurer les besoins en blocs fonctionnels, exigences et trajectoires de transformation.

• Garantir l'adéquation entre les attentes métier et les solutions numériques déployées.

• Coordonner l'analyse des solutions et contribuer au cadrage des offres lorsque nécessaire.

• Arbitrer l'utilisation des composants transverses existants, notamment ERP Odoo, MonEspace, Alfresco, COSI, les services géomatiques et les portails web.

• Piloter l'urbanisation du SI, l'intégration applicative et l'interopérabilité de l'ensemble des solutions.

Position Summary:

The Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist will work as an integral member of the research staff by maintaining day-to-day regulatory tasks within the site network, assisting with the execution of clinical studies in accordance with the protocol, contract scope of work, ICH/GCP, sponsor, CRO, Rovia SOPs, and any relevant local guidelines and regulations.

• Routes regulatory documents to research staff and investigators to obtain signatures and follow up as necessary.

• Works collaboratively with investigators and research staff to complete outstanding documents.

• Returns regulatory documents and credentials to the sponsor/CRO in a timely manner.

• Creates delegation of authority logs and adjusts as needed throughout the study duration.

• Creates training logs.

• Performs reviews of the Investigator Site Files (ISFs) for completion and accuracy.

• Participates in the development of company SOPs and Guidance Documents (GDs) as needed.

• May perform other job-related duties as requested or required.

Skills/Abilities:

• Sound knowledge of medical terminology.

• Sound knowledge of ICH/GCP, Regulatory requirements, FDA and HIPAA policies and practices.

• Excellent interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clinicians, patients, administrators, auxiliary personnel, regulators, monitors, and sponsors.

• Meticulous attention to detail.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality.

• Strong written communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills.

• Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Microsoft Excel, and Adobe Acrobat.

• Ability to meet multiple and changing deadlines

• Ability to consult numerous sources for information to prepare documents.

• Fluent in spoken and written English.

Education/Experience:

• High school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.

• 1-2 years of clinical research experience with an emphasis in regulatory and QA.

• License/certification status with CEUs, as applicable.

• Current GCP certification.

title: PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science
company: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester
description: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester | PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science | ONSITE | UK home fee status only | £30k tax-free annual stipend Our group at Cambridge works on Earth Observation foundation models (Tessera: v1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20380 , v2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03949 , https://geotessera.org/ ) and we've started a collaboration with Manchester to understand how they can be used to improve pollution models and then environmental decision making in general. This involves training new models and doing high-resolution inference across national or even global scales, as well as figuring out how to use that data to help policymakers make better decisions. As part of this work we have a PhD studentship through the joint Manchester-Cambridge Centre for Doctoral Training for AI in Decision Making for Complex Systems. This involves one year at Manchester doing taught postgraduate study and then three years at Cambridge for the PhD. Our work is all open source and involves solving significant compute and data challenges. Training our current-generation model takes ~250k GPU hours and a single year of global inference needs to move over 5.5 petabytes of data through the inference pipeline. This project would suit someone with strong machine learning and software engineering experience. We can help you build the atmospheric science and Earth Observation skills. We are a highly collaborative group who spend our time not only on foundational research but also on developing applications with practitioners and decision makers. Our work sees use in many industrial, academic and government environments for problems like crop classification, tree species mapping and change detection. You can find out more here: https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/from-satellite-to-stre... - if you have questions about the project you can contact me, Sadiq Jaffer, at sj514@cam.ac.uk . This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Product Engineer (Client Platform)

(€70K - €95K)

We're looking for a Product Engineer to develop our Client Platform: A system to handle and allow our Clients to operate all of their work easily with us.

The goal is to build a minimal, usable platform that lets clients do every important action themselves. It automates what can be automated and makes the rest easy to see and act on.

Our Client Platform sits at the core of our business, so what you build will directly shape how our clients work with us every day.

Tech Stack

- Python + FastAPI

- TypeScript + NestJS, NextJS

- dbt, BigQuery, Hex, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

- Google Cloud Platform

What You’ll Do 🎯

- Develop self-serve application features for our Business Clients & Internal Growth Management Team,

- Own the data, backend & frontend implementation for your domains, interface clearly with Data, Engineering & Growth Teams,

- Leverage LLMs, and chat agents while maintaining your own understanding of what you built at the correct layer of abstraction & actively contribute to our AI Engineering environment.

What You’ll Bring 🚀

- Experience with our tech stack or similar tools

- A passion for building features end to end, from backend logic to the user interface

- Comfort with AI-assisted development and agent-based coding tools in your daily workflow

- A habit of keeping systems strictly typed, documented and organized

- Enjoying communication and the ability to organize projects across teams

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

- You’re driven by results you can actually see: what you build becomes part of how our clients work everyday with us

- You like seeing the full picture of how a product works, not just one layer of it

- You turn open questions from clients and non-technical teams into clear decisions about what to build

- You have a strong intuition for what to build and how to bring it to life

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Staff Engineer I - Software Development Insight
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer to drive the technical architecture and strategic development of our cloud-based NMS platform. This role combines deep networking expertise with full-stack engineering leadership to build enterprise-grade solutions that manage complex network infrastructures for our global customer base.

Key Responsibilities

- Platform Architecture: Design scalable, multi-tenant architecture for managing thousands of network devices across customer environments

- Advanced Network Analytics: Lead development of AI/ML-powered network analytics, predictive maintenance, and automated troubleshooting capabilities

- Enterprise Integration: Architect integrations with major network vendors' management platforms and enterprise IT systems

- Performance Engineering: Optimize platform performance for handling massive telemetry data streams from network devices

- Security Architecture: Design zero-trust security models for secure device access and customer data protection

- Distributed Systems: Expert-level experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed data processing

- Machine Learning: Experience applying ML to network analytics, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance

- Network Security: Deep understanding of network security protocols, certificate management, and secure device provisioning

- Multi-vendor Integration: Extensive experience with network vendor APIs and management protocols across different manufacturers

- Performance Optimization: Expert knowledge of database optimization for time-series data and high-throughput network metrics

- Cloud Networking: Advanced knowledge of cloud networking services, VPC design, and hybrid cloud architectures

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or Electrical Engineering

- 14+ years of software development experience with 5+ years in network management systems

- Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies and network operations centers (NOC)

- Experience with major network vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Fortinet, etc.) and their management APIs

- Proven track record building SaaS platforms serving enterprise customers

- Experience with network certification programs (CCNA/CCNP knowledge preferred)

- Strong background in both software engineering and network infrastructure

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.  

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. title: Strategic Director - CVA, Texas
description:
About Concerned Veterans for America 
Concerned Veterans for America (CVA) is the only national grassroots organization which is purpose-built to amplify veteran’s voices across every aspect of American government and civil society. 
We believe that veterans are a powerful force for driving solutions to America’s most pressing challenges. We build engaged communities of empowered veterans and patriotic Americans to amplify our unique perspectives on critical issues-from foreign policy to health care to federal spending. We understand the meaning of service, and we remain committed to serving our fellow Americans and strengthening our country. 
Concerned Veterans for America is a part of Americans for Prosperity and the Stand Together philanthropic community.  
 

As the Strategic Director, Texas, you'll be the senior voice and strategic leader for CVA in the Lone Star State. Working alongside Americans for Prosperity (AFP) and LIBRE Initiative leadership and allied organizations, you'll build powerful coalitions, set statewide strategy, and advance liberty-based policy solutions for a freer, more secure America, with a focus on Texas's veteran communities.  

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: Product Marketing Manager / Senior Manager - Commercial Content
description:

Job Location: Boston, MA
Job Location Type: Remote

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

We are in search of exceptional product marketing talent to help us promote highly scalable, true multitenant cloud solutions that are significantly impacting life sciences. Our focus is on customer satisfaction, employee success, and growth.

Requirements

• 3+ years of B2B product marketing experience

• Strong project management skills with attention to detail

• Fast learner, and must enjoy fast-paced work environments

• Proven ability to build relationships with other teams and stakeholders

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

title: Security Engineer, Privy
description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo - powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy:  Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

• High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

• Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

• Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use  boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

What you’ll do

As a Security Engineer at Privy, you will help keep a rapidly growing platform secure through hands-on investigation, operational ownership, and building real code to solve real problems. You’ll work across security operations, incident response, application and infrastructure security, and internal tooling.

This is not a role limited to reviewing logs and designs or simply escalating findings. You will carry real ownership for the day-to-day work that protects Privy: investigating anomalies, improving security workflows, and building the automation that makes the team faster and more effective over time. You’ll work closely with engineers across Privy and alongside specialists in cryptography, application security, offensive security, and infrastructure security to turn security expertise into practical, durable outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Own security engineering work end to end: investigate alerts, findings, anomalies, and security requests; identify root causes; drive remediation; and clearly document outcomes.

• Participate in Privy’s security on-call rotation, helping respond to incidents, triage alerts, support vulnerability workflows, complete access reviews, and handle security escalations.

• Build and maintain production-quality tooling that reduces manual work, including alert enrichment, automated triage and routing, remediation workflows, access-review automation, and detection improvements.

• Lead focused investigations into suspected security events or compromises, gathering evidence methodically and coordinating the appropriate response.

• Proactively identify recurring sources of operational toil and engineer durable solutions that improve the team’s speed, consistency, and ability to scale.

• Partner with product and engineering teams to assess security risks, review lower-complexity designs and implementation plans, and make practical security tradeoffs to deliver quickly with quality and soundness.

• Contribute across Privy’s application, infrastructure, cloud, and product-security surface area, developing broad context while building deeper expertise over time.

• Execute structured testing roadmaps (messaging, segmentation, timing, channels) to optimize engagement.

title: Network and Security Engineer, Defense
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Network and Security Engineer to own the architecture of high-performance, high-assurance networks for our defense programs. You will design networks that move terabits of radar, camera, and vehicle data with low, predictable latency, and you will secure those networks to the standard needed for classified environments up to Impact Level 6 (IL6). This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who has spent a career solving hard networking and security problems and wants to keep doing so directly, while shaping technical direction across our defense programs and growing into broader technical leadership. At Applied, we encourage engineers to own technical and product decisions, work closely with customers and users, and contribute to a thoughtful, dynamic team culture.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Architect and build high-bandwidth network fabrics (100/400/800GbE) that carry mixed radar, EO/IR camera, and vehicle bus data from the sensor edge to compute and storage

- Design for deterministic, low-latency transport using techniques such as Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), precision time synchronization (PTP/IEEE 1588), RDMA/RoCEv2, and multicast for sensor distribution

- Bridge in-vehicle networks (automotive Ethernet, CAN, and legacy military buses) with modern IP-based backbones in rugged, size- and power-limited platforms

- Design and implement security architectures that support IL5/IL6 accreditation, including network segmentation, encryption in transit (MACsec, IPsec, CSfC-style layered encryption), PKI, and cross-domain data flows

- Apply zero trust principles across on-prem, tactical edge, and cloud environments rather than relying on perimeter-only defenses

- Automate network and security configuration with infrastructure as code, and build continuous compliance checks into deployment pipelines in place of manual, document-driven processes

- Build observability into the network through streaming telemetry, flow analysis, and security monitoring so that problems and threats surface quickly

- Translate Navy and DoD guidance into practical engineering decisions, adopting the intent of those standards while pushing toward modern, maintainable solutions

- Work directly with customers, government stakeholders, and product teams across Applied to understand mission needs and deployment constraints

- Set the technical roadmap for defense networking and security, lead design reviews, mentor engineers across teams, and serve as a trusted technical voice with customers and government stakeholders

title: Vice-président principal, Opérations nationales/Senior Vice President, National
description:

We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Vice-président principal, Opérations nationales/Senior Vice President, National Operations OBJECTIF DU POSTE
Le vice-président principal des Opérations nationales supervise toutes les opérations sur le terrain liées à l’ensemble des services que Sedgwick offre et développe (y compris les systèmes d’exploitation). Il dirige les changements et la stratégie opérationnels et organisationnels. Le vice-président principal, Opérations, est responsable d’optimiser la marge de profit et d’assurer une prestation de services de grande qualité.
FONCTIONS ET RESPONSABILITÉS ESSENTIELLES

• Créer et exécuter le plan stratégique des Opérations sur le terrain.

• Atteindre le budget annuel des Opérations sur le terrain.

• Examiner les rapports d’exploitation mensuels afin de tirer parti des réussites dans l’ensemble du réseau et de corriger rapidement les secteurs problématiques.

• Gérer les principaux indicateurs de marge de profit, tels que les travaux en cours vieillissants, la gestion des comptes clients et l’utilisation des experts en sinistres.

• Représenter l’entreprise lors d’activités de l’industrie, de congrès et d’événements locaux, dans la mesure du possible.

• Participer à titre de membre clé du Comité de tarification.

• Superviser la qualité des services et des dossiers, et cerner les tendances et les possibilités.

• Veiller à ce qu’un processus d’escalade efficace soit en place et à ce que les plaintes et les demandes de renseignements des clients soient traitées de façon appropriée.

• Collaborer avec le Service juridique afin de maintenir la conformité des opérations sur le terrain et de réduire l’exposition potentielle aux erreurs et omissions (E&O).

• Être en mesure d’expliquer et de défendre les décisions avec tact et clarté. Faire preuve de maturité et de résistance au stress, tout en démontrant la souplesse nécessaire pour s’adapter lorsque requis.

• La capacité de résoudre des problèmes complexes, notamment de définir les problèmes, d’interpréter les données financières et opérationnelles, de tirer des conclusions et d’agir de façon appropriée, est essentielle, tout comme la capacité de comprendre l’incidence des décisions sur l’entreprise, les clients et/ou les employés.

FONCTIONS ET RESPONSABILITÉS SUPPLÉMENTAIRES

• Exécuter d’autres tâches qui lui sont confiées.

• Soutenir le ou les programmes de qualité de l’organisation.

· Voyager selon les besoins.
QUALIFICATIONS
Formation et permis
Une maîtrise est préférable. Un baccalauréat (B.A. ou B.Sc.) d’un collège ou d’une université offrant un programme de quatre ans est exigé au minimum; ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience dans le domaine de l’expertise en sinistres ou de l’assurance.
Les titres professionnels de l’industrie sont souhaitables.
Expérience
Expérience antérieure en gestion des résultats financiers (P&L) et en gestion par l’entremise de gestionnaires de personnel. Expérience dans le secteur de l’assurance et/ou de l’expertise en sinistres. Esprit stratégique.
Compétences et connaissances

• Les compétences interpersonnelles doivent comprendre, sans toutefois s’y limiter, l’accessibilité, l’influence, l’accompagnement et le mentorat, l’écoute, la responsabilisation, le renforcement d’équipe et le perfectionnement du personnel.

• Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer oralement et par écrit.

• Capacité de comprendre et de préparer des rapports complexes, y compris des plans d’affaires et des budgets.

• Capacité d’interagir efficacement avec les clients et les employés de tous les niveaux et de projeter une image professionnelle.

• Excellentes compétences informatiques.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/3519e886-495e-4d41-8a3b-439b2a607aea/pictures.jpg]

THE CONTEXT

Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load.

That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US.

You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting.

YOUR MISSION

1. OWN THE PEOPLE SYSTEMS STACK AND MAKE IT WORK ACROSS EVERY COUNTRY

You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies.

- Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire

- Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover

- Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US

- Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste

- Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement

2. BUILD AN EMPLOYEE LIFECYCLE THAT FEELS EFFORTLESS AT 2X OUR SIZE

Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in.

- Design onboarding, internal moves and offboarding flows with recruiting and L&D

- Turn tribal knowledge into documented processes and self-serve answers

- Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

- Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

3. RUN THE PEOPLE CYCLES THE COMPANY DEPENDS ON

Performance reviews, compensation and salary increases should run on time, every time, without pulling Claudia into the detail.

- Own the performance cycle calendar, tooling and manager enablement

- Run compensation projects and salary review cycles with Claudia and Finance

- Keep bands, levels and approvals applied consistently

- Spot what slowed each cycle down and fix it before the next one

4. TURN PEOPLE DATA INTO DECISIONS

Leadership should be able to answer people questions in minutes, with numbers they trust.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Layer1
description:
Who You’ll Work With
As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.
Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Layer1 software , the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.
Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from Layer1 to other areas, if you like.
What You’ll Do

• Interface with customers, product management and hardware engineers to come up with innovative new Layer1 features.

• Architect, design and manage the development of these features.

• Develop and maintain features using C, C++ and Python , review and contribute to functional and design specifications. Build automated tests and test infrastructure to test the features.

• Work with hardware and manufacturing teams to bring new Layer1 components like Phys and Transceivers to market.

• Collaborate with hardware engineers to design optimal software control interfaces for managing Layer1 components.

• Provide technical leadership across features, projects and tools.

• Work with Customer Support Engineers and customers to analyze, mitigate and fix problems in customer networks.

• Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems.

• Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment.

• BS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering + 8 years experience, or equivalent work experience

• Expert knowledge of C or C++ and Python .

• Knowledge of UNIX or Linux

• Knowledge of digital communication technologies like modulation and signal encoding schemes is a plus.

• Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus

• Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus

• Applied understanding of software engineering principles

• Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills

• Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.

• Ability to work in small teams.

About the role
Our client in the UK is looking for an experienced Payroll & Bookkeeping Specialist to join their UK-based accounting practice. This role is suited to someone with strong UK payroll and bookkeeping experience who can independently manage a portfolio of clients, take ownership of their accounts and act as their first point of contact.
You will be responsible for end-to-end payroll processing, bookkeeping, CIS returns and VAT preparation across multiple UK clients. You will work closely with the Operations Director, ensuring accuracy, meeting deadlines and maintaining strong client relationships.
This position offers an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop into a senior position, with a clear progression pathway towards reviewing work and eventually overseeing the bookkeeping team.
Responsibilities

• Manage your own portfolio of UK payroll, bookkeeping and CIS clients, acting as their primary point of contact.

• Prepare and submit monthly CIS returns, including contractor verifications and deductions.

• Handle full-cycle bookkeeping, including bank reconciliations, purchase and sales ledgers, month-end processes and UK VAT returns in line with Making Tax Digital (MTD) requirements.

• Maintain accurate financial records, manage deadlines and communicate directly with clients regarding their payroll and bookkeeping needs.

• Work closely with the Operations Director, taking responsibility for the quality and accuracy of your work while progressively taking on additional responsibilities.

Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on UK payroll experience within an accounting practice, payroll bureau or outsourced environment, managing multiple external client payrolls (both weekly and monthly). Single in-house payroll experience will not meet the requirement.

• Strong knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC systems, including RTI (FPS/EPS), auto-enrolment, statutory payments, P11Ds, P60s and year-end procedures.

• Practical experience preparing and submitting monthly CIS returns, including contractor verifications, deductions and CIS300 submissions.

• Strong UK bookkeeping experience across multiple clients, including reconciliations, ledgers, month-end processes and VAT returns under MTD.

•
Strong Xero experience is essential , with BrightPay experience strongly preferred. Familiarity with Karbon, Dext or AutoEntry would be advantageous.

• Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts independently.

• Confident communication skills, with the ability to handle client calls and build trusted client relationships.

• AAT, ACCA, CIMA, SAIPA or CIPP qualifications, Xero or BrightPay certifications, and previous experience reviewing work or supervising junior team members would be advantageous.

Role Progression
The successful candidate will initially focus on managing their own portfolio of payroll, bookkeeping and CIS clients, with regular guidance and reviews from the Operations Director.
Within the first 90 days, the expectation is to manage payrolls accurately and on time, build trusted client relationships and progressively work with greater independence.
Following a performance review at 6-9 months, there will be an opportunity to take on responsibility for reviewing other bookkeepers' work and VAT returns, with the longer-term progression towards overseeing the bookkeeping team.

title: Technical Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
description:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role sits on the Risk Incubation & Systems (RIS) team, which investigates emerging risks, builds data and automation capabilities, and develops workflows that can scale into durable operational homes.

About the Role

You’ll build and maintain the data pipelines and shared datasets that teams across USRO use for analysis, measurement, and automation. Working with operational teams and engineers, you’ll turn data from different systems into reliable sources that colleagues can use in their work.

You’ll take projects from initial requirements through to production use, with responsibility for testing and documentation. As teams’ needs change, you’ll help maintain and extend the systems you build.

Location / work model: San Francisco based with three days in the office. 

Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.

In This Role, You Will

- Work with USRO teams to understand their data needs and define requirements for datasets and reporting.

- Build, maintain, and monitor production data pipelines and Airflow DAGs, including scheduling, dependencies, backfills, and troubleshooting failures. 

- Build and maintain reusable data models, reporting cubes, and shared operational reporting metrics, so teams can use consistent definitions across dashboards and analyses.

- Set up data quality and freshness checks, document lineage and ownership, and make the work supportable after handoff.

- Document data sources and transformations so colleagues can trace results back to the underlying records.Apply access and privacy requirements when designing datasets and reporting.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

- Have strong SQL skills and practical experience using Python to build and maintain data pipelines.

- Have built and debugged scheduled pipelines that other people depend on.

- Practical understanding of data modeling, joins, deduplication, tests, and monitoring.

- Ability to trace a surprising metric back to its inputs and explain what downstream users can and can’t conclude.

- Experience partnering with non-engineers to turn ambiguous needs into dependable data products.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools.

- Experience transferring prototypes or new workflows into reliable, scaled operations.

About OpenAI
